question: How do two agents — a planner and a worker — follow one CommHub MCP task protocol to reliably complete the dispatch, execution, reporting and verification loop?
trigger: The user asks to dispatch a task, take a task, verify work, or debug a stalled task
A new session's agent needs to connect to the commhub / agent-network MCP
Protocol failures such as alias_not_found, a task stopped in acked, or report_completion having no effect
decision: Call the MCP tools according to the role flows and state machine defined in SKILL.md
When a parameter mismatch stalls the state, repair it per Gotchas (cancel/retry, or add the correct completion)
Judge cross-machine results from the hub task row only — never read the other side's directory
evidence: CommHub source tree docs-site/docs/api/mcp-tools.md — tool signatures and side effects
CommHub source tree server/src/tools.ts — the state machine's exact-match logic
Postmortems and verification of the cross-machine two-agent loop (exact task-body matching, ack/working/completion order)
success_measure: The planner dispatches per the hard rules and the worker acks, reports working, and sends exactly one completion per task, so every task flips to replied on the hub and verification is read-only via get_task
outcome: Two agents complete a verifiable task loop under one protocol

examples.invocation: /agent-network-skill split this round's work and dispatch it to <worker-alias>
examples.description: The planner dispatches per the hard rules: self-contained body, ttl 86400, "do it in your working directory"

examples.invocation: /agent-network-skill take a task and report per protocol (worker side)
examples.description: The worker consumes in order: register, ack, working with the verbatim body, exactly one completion per task

permissions_systems: Read the hub token from an environment variable or local config
Read and write the git repository of the project that mounted this skill

required_capabilities: Read the hub token from an environment variable or local config
Call the MCP tools as specified in SKILL.md
readiness_checks: The MCP tool set is visible (connected)
The token exists and is the right kind (planner: utok/atok; worker: ntok)
The worker alias already has a session row on the hub

permissions: Dispatch tasks to the hub (send_task wakes the recipient AI)
Modify hub task and session state
Read and write the git repository of the project that mounted this skill
approval_required: Dispatching and verifying are triggered by the operator's instruction; the planner stops once dispatches are sent

should_trigger: take a task and report per protocol
how do I fix a task stuck in acked
任务卡在 acked 怎么修
should_not_trigger: deploy or upgrade the CommHub server
